pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/_shell/facts.ts:1 The shell computes header numbers, session cookies, toasts and the live feed and builds no model prompt: a search of app/(studio)/_shell/ for prompt, systemPrompt, anthropic and max_tokens found nothing (the only 'token' hits are Firebase ID tokens and design tokens), so the subject's precondition, a system that owns a prompt assembler, does not hold here.

pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/PartEditor.tsx:3 These editors only send typed ops to the part port and assemble no prompt. The one 'prompt' hit, in Notebook.tsx, is the operator's raw follow-up question sent as an op field; the server-side followUpPrompt assembles it. A search for systemPrompt, max_tokens, anthropic and compaction found nothing in the editor directory.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Notebook.tsx:118 The call site sends a typed task input, never pre-rendered prompt text, so this context owns no assembler.
